description.p1: Hi! My name is <1>Amanda Souza</1>, I am a front-end developer and a postgraduate student in <1>Software Engineering</1> at the University of São Paulo (USP). I hold a degree in <1>Systems Analysis and Development</1> from the Federal Institute of São Paulo (IFSP) and a technical degree in Informatics from FIEB.

expertise.title: Focus Areas
expertise.text: I have a special interest in <1>front-end</1> development, accessible interfaces, and software quality. I have experience with <1>Vue.js</1>, <1>React</1>, <1>JavaScript</1>, <1>HTML</1>, <1>CSS</1>, and consuming back-end services. I am also deepening my studies in <1>QA</1>, focused on testing, best practices, and continuous improvement of application quality.

backend.company: Portal Telemedicina • Barueri, São Paulo, Brazil
backend.stack: Vue.js | React | Figma | JavaScript | HTML | CSS | APIs | Maintenance | Front-end | QA | Cypress | E2E tests
activities: Front-end development for healthcare applications, focused on functional, accessible, and well-structured interfaces for healthcare managers and professionals.
Member of the development team using agile methodology.
Maintenance of a Vue.js project that will become legacy in the future, handling fixes, adjustments, and evolution of existing screens.
Participation in the transfer/evolution of the new project to React, following Figma prototypes and contributing to componentized interfaces, visual organization, and front-end codebase evolution.
Creation of POCs (proofs of concept) to validate solutions, interface flows, and technical feasibility before moving to final implementation.
Maintenance and evolution of applications with Vue.js, React, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS, plus consuming back-end services to connect screens and business rules.
Creation and maintenance of E2E tests with Cypress to validate critical application flows.
Software analysis and development considering security, scalability, automated tests, and microservices-oriented architecture.
Development following best practices, code standards, and agile workflows, with attention to quality, usability, and continuous improvement of applications.
Support for delivery quality through bug identification, flow analysis, and attention to user experience.

international.title: International Journey
international.role: Runner-up at Huawei ICT Competition Global Final (2022-2023)
international.stack: Innovation | Tech Care | Web Voice Assistant | Healthcare | Global Competition
activities: On-site participation in the Huawei ICT Competition Global Final, Innovation category, in Shenzhen, China.
Presentation of Tech Care, a virtual assistant designed for doctors during surgical procedures.
The application allowed laboratory images to be consulted through voice commands, bringing more practicality to surgeons.
Achieved 2nd place worldwide in the category, representing IFSP and Brazil in the global stage.

list.title: Web POS
list.description: Web POS system for sales operations and an administrative dashboard, built with React, TypeScript, Vite, and Firebase. The project is also used to study state management with TanStack Query, Redux, and Redux Saga.

list.title: Task Manager
list.description: Full stack Kanban task management application with user collaboration, JWT authentication, Vue.js, Node.js, Express, and MySQL. Focused on workflow organization, productivity, and front-end/back-end integration.

list.title: Speech to Text APIs
list.description: POCs comparing Speech-to-Text APIs with Amazon Transcribe, Azure Speech, Google Cloud Speech-to-Text, and OpenAI Whisper. The project explores external service integration and technical alternative analysis for audio transcription.

list.title: DIO UX Designer Training
list.description: Practical challenges from DIO UX Designer training, with wireframe, design system, and navigable prototype created in Figma for an online bookstore. Focused on UX/UI practice, visual structure, and prototyping.

list.title: Task System
list.description: REST API for user and task management, developed with C#, ASP.NET Core Web API, Entity Framework Core, and SQL Server. Focused on back-end structure, endpoints, data persistence, and Swagger documentation.

list.title: Electronic Ticketing
list.description: Web project about electronic ticketing. The application works as a CRUD system for managing ticketing-related data, allowing users to create, list, edit, and delete records, using ASP.NET MVC, C#, Entity Framework, and SQL Server.

list.title: Web Ada
list.description: Web application started as a team project for the Huawei ICT Competition and later evolved as a final course project. The ADA system supports healthcare professionals in viewing patient information and exam images through voice commands, including the "ADA" command, external API integrations, and AWS services via Amazon API Gateway. Private GitHub repository because it is a fork of the original project.
